sentences.text: Heard Mr. Shailendra Kumar Jha, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. Jitendra Kumar Singh for the State as also Mr. Sajid Salim Khan representing the informant.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Phulparash P.S. Case No. 158 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. No. 590 of 2024 for the offence registered under sections 341, 323, 498A,
379, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and  of D.P. Act.

3. For the proper appreciation of the case, let the legible copy of the case diary as also the criminal antecedent report be called for from the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Jhanjharpur, Madhubani in connection with Phulparash P.S. Case No. 158 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. No. 590 of 2024.
4. Let the matter come up under the same heading on Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24364 of 2025(6) dt.03-12-2025 12.12.2025.
5.
In the meantime, the parties are free to file affidavit as the copy of the I.A. has been served upon the learned counsel for the petitioner today itself.

6. Let the name of Mr. Jitendra Kumar Singh appear in the cause list and the name of Mr. Dashrath Md. Amir @ Md. Aamir vs The State Of Bihar on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64628279/
